# Step 1: fetch all liked songs
liked_song_ids = set()
liked_album_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
pages = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    pages += 1
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
        liked_album_ids.add(s['album_id'])
    # If fewer than limit, likely last page; but still safest to check empty next page
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        # Try next page to be sure
        page_index += 1
        next_page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not next_page:
            break
        # Otherwise process next page in loop style
        page = next_page
        for s in page:
            liked_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
            liked_album_ids.add(s['album_id'])
        break
    page_index += 1
print('liked_songs_count', len(liked_song_ids))
print('liked_albums_count_from_songs', len(liked_album_ids))
print('liked_song_ids_sample', list(sorted(liked_song_ids))[:10])

# Step 3: fetch full album library and compute albums to keep/remove
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
album_library = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        album_library.append(a)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

album_library_album_ids = set(a['album_id'] for a in album_library)
print('album_library_total', len(album_library_album_ids))

# Determine which album libraries to keep: liked OR fully downloaded (all its songs downloaded)
keep_album_ids = set()
albums_downloaded_flags = []
for a in album_library:
    album_id = a['album_id']
    song_ids = set(a.get('song_ids', []))
    is_downloaded = len(song_ids) > 0 and song_ids.issubset(downloaded_song_ids)
    is_liked = album_id in liked_album_ids
    if is_liked or is_downloaded:
        keep_album_ids.add(album_id)
    albums_downloaded_flags.append((album_id, is_liked, is_downloaded, len(song_ids)))

remove_album_ids = album_library_album_ids.difference(keep_album_ids)
print('liked_album_ids_count', len(liked_album_ids))
print('keep_album_ids_count', len(keep_album_ids))
print('albums_to_remove_count', len(remove_album_ids))
print('albums_to_remove_sample', sorted(remove_album_ids)[:30])

# Print breakdown of a few albums for sanity
albums_sorted = sorted(albums_downloaded_flags, key=lambda x: x[0])
print('album_library_breakdown_sample', albums_sorted[:10])
print('album_library_breakdown_sample_last', albums_sorted[-10:])

# Verification: re-fetch song library and confirm all remaining songs are liked or downloaded
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
remaining_song_ids = set()
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        remaining_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

songs_not_keep = sorted(list(remaining_song_ids.difference(liked_song_ids.union(downloaded_song_ids))))
print('remaining_song_library_total', len(remaining_song_ids))
print('songs_not_keep_count', len(songs_not_keep))
print('songs_not_keep_sample', songs_not_keep[:50])

# Verification: re-fetch album library and confirm all remaining albums are liked or fully downloaded
page_index = 0
album_library_remaining = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    album_library_remaining.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

remaining_album_ids = set(a['album_id'] for a in album_library_remaining)
violating_album_ids = []
for a in album_library_remaining:
    album_id = a['album_id']
    song_ids = set(a.get('song_ids', []))
    is_downloaded = len(song_ids) > 0 and song_ids.issubset(downloaded_song_ids)
    is_liked = album_id in liked_album_ids
    if not (is_downloaded or is_liked):
        violating_album_ids.append(album_id)

violating_album_ids = sorted(violating_album_ids)
print('remaining_album_library_total', len(remaining_album_ids))
print('albums_violating_count', len(violating_album_ids))
print('albums_violating_sample', violating_album_ids[:50])
